name: Maricopa County

actions.title: (City of Mesa) Mesa Data Center Tax Incentive & Utility Agreement with Switch
actions.summary: Mesa has long hosted major data center campuses including Switch's 1-million-sq-ft facility, with city-negotiated utility and tax incentive agreements; ongoing expansions through 2024–2025 continue to draw scrutiny over water and grid impacts.

actions.title: (City of Goodyear) Goodyear Data Center Zoning Approvals and Industrial Growth
actions.summary: Goodyear city council approved zoning amendments to accommodate large-scale data center development in its industrial corridors, citing economic development goals while residents raised concerns about water use and noise.

actions.title: (City of Phoenix) Phoenix Data Center Zoning and Water-Use Review
actions.summary: The City of Phoenix initiated a review of zoning and water-consumption standards for data centers amid rapid growth in AI-driven demand, with city council members requesting an assessment of cumulative water impacts from hyperscale facilities.

contextBlurb: Maricopa County is Arizona's primary data center hub, hosting campuses for Switch, CyberNAP, Iron Mountain, and hyperscalers in Mesa, Phoenix, Goodyear, and Chandler. Rapid AI-driven expansion has intensified debate over water use in the drought-stressed Salt River Valley and strain on SRP and APS electrical grids.
